risks.risk: Grill function may not work (or may be missing/weak), even if microwave heats.
risks.proof: A short video showing the grill mode running (or a photo of the grill heating element inside the cavity) plus a timed test result (e.g., heating water/food).
risks.if_unproven: Price as microwave only / not confirmed grill working.

risks.risk: Microwave may not heat properly (magnetron/diode issues) despite looking clean.
risks.proof: A power-on test: set to a known time/power and show heating (e.g., thermometer reading or steaming water after 1–2 minutes).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable as worst case for unverified working condition.

risks.risk: Capacity/brand variant may differ from what buyers expect (affects value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate/spec label showing liters/capacity and model number.
risks.if_unproven: Price using generic used microwave value (worst case within the provided comparables).

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating plate/spec label (capacity in liters + model).
Send a short video: microwave mode test (show time/power setting and result).
Send a short video: grill mode test (show grill mode selected and heating result).
Optional: photo of the inside cavity showing the grill heating element.
response.reason: The photo confirms it is a used microwave oven, but grill functionality and working condition are not proven remotely; so it should be priced at the worst case among matching used microwaves.
